data.name: Lower Limpopo river floods (Chokwe to Xai-Xai)

period.reported: Dec 2025 - late Jan 2026 (Limpopo flooding at Xai-Xai 19 Jan)

data.cause: Lower Limpopo river flood; much of the water came from rain upstream, outside the box
notes: River flood: this flood was driven by the river, so much of the water came from rain upstream, outside this box. Rain over the box shows only the local part.
